title: “老登”AI，精髓是作秀
content: Lenovo's latest earnings beat expectations, with 43% revenue growth and a 20% stock surge, driven by AI infrastructure demand. However, its ISG profit leap from $73M annually to $777M quarterly reflects industry-wide AI capital spending rather than unique strategy. The article argues traditional IT firms like Lenovo face a dilemma: missing AI risks market irrelevance, yet genuine AI investment threatens profits. Their practical solution is "performative" AI—rebranding existing products with AI labels, partnering rather than building core tech, and maintaining conservative spending while crafting compelling narratives. Lenovo exemplifies this: AI revenue includes NPU-equipped PCs and GPU servers, but underlying demand remains unclear; operating cash flow actually declined despite soaring profits.

title: [吐槽] OpenCode 惊现 两年虫 大 bug，线上业务几千个会话在同一时间一起炸了...
content: A two-year timestamp overflow bug in OpenCode caused message IDs to wrap around after ~795 days, making new messages appear older than existing ones. This broke message.latest() lookups, stalling thousands of live chat sessions simultaneously. The 48-bit truncated timestamp reset from msg_ffff to msg_0000 on August 14 at 19:19. Affected sessions in retry loops risked exhausting token quotas. The issue was reported and fixed, though without official notice.

title: 奥德赛、龙餐馆，是电影的解药吗？
content: High ratings no longer guarantee box office success in China's film market. This summer, acclaimed films like Nolan's "The Odyssey" and Shen Teng's "Welcome to the Dragon Restaurant" opened strong with core fans but failed to break into wider audiences. Moviegoing faces growing competition from short videos, gaming, and streaming. While IMAX spectacle and star power still attract viewers, they struggle to create true nationwide blockbusters. AI offers production cost reductions but doesn't solve the fundamental challenge of convincing audiences to leave home for theaters.

title: 刚刚，Claude文字水印细节全曝光，官方检测工具即将推出
content: Anthropic has detailed how it's implementing text watermarking for Claude to comply with the EU AI Act, using Google DeepMind's SynthID-Text method. The watermark subtly alters the randomness source in Claude's word selection without adding visible content, hidden characters, or extra tokens. It won't identify individual users, noticeably affect output quality, or increase costs. However, the author questions whether "negligible" effects truly mean zero impact across all tasks and lengths. A watermark detection API is coming soon. Image files will use C2PA metadata instead. The mechanism will apply globally due to lack of reliable regional differentiation, and will eventually cover older models too.

title: 如何看待DeepSeek-V4 Pro正式版疑似过拟合DeepSeek Harness的极简模式？
content: Community analysis reveals DeepSeek-V4 Pro exhibits significant performance sensitivity to initial tool exposure. In Standard mode with 25 visible tools, the model scores 9,192 on Project2, but in Minimal mode with only Shell and Read tools, it returns to its expected gray-test reasoning trajectory, scoring 9,699. The open-source dsh-anchored-standard plugin solves this by exposing two core tools initially, then unlocking all 25 tools after the first tool call, achieving 98-99 scores. This suggests the model was overfitted during RL training to specific scaffolding configurations in the DeepSeek Harness evaluation environment.

title: 感染新冠，会唤醒体内的“休眠病毒”？！Nature重磅：新冠急性发病期，患者检出多种重新激活的潜伏病毒，加剧长新冠症状 | 原文
content: A Nature study found that during acute COVID-19 infection, multiple latent viruses become reactivated in patients, worsening long COVID symptoms. Researchers at the University of Texas identified reactivation of dormant viruses as a factor contributing to persistent post-infection symptoms such as fatigue and cognitive decline, challenging the perception of COVID-19 as merely a brief, mild illness.

title: Codex 重置是什么力度的活动？可能没有想象的那么多
content: OpenAI's Codex resets, despite appearing generous, likely increase server load by under 50% compared to natural resets. A developer built an analytical tool showing that user consumption patterns—how quickly people exhaust their credits—affect the actual impact. The irregular timing creates more engagement and surprise value than a straightforward 50% boost. Immediate users maximize gains, while those with delayed natural resets bear inconvenience without benefit.

title: From Models to Agents: Building Context-Aware Consumer AI at Scale at DoorDash
How to bring your software delivery workflow into GitHub with agent apps
content: GitHub agent apps integrate third-party tools directly into pull request workflows, reducing context switching. Developers can use agents like Amplitude for product analytics, Endor Labs for dependency security checks, LaunchDarkly for feature flag management, and PagerDuty for deployment risk assessment—all via @mentions in GitHub comments or the Agents tab. These agents automate tasks such as querying user behavior data, identifying vulnerabilities, creating feature flags with staged rollouts, and evaluating service health before deployment. Additional inaugural agents from Packfiles, Miro, Bright Security, SonarQube, and Octopus Deploy are available in the GitHub Marketplace.
